name: generaldyg_btc_otc
description: Bitcoin OTC trust network preprocessed for GeneralDyG (3 anomaly-injection rates: 1%, 5%, 10%).
format: btc_otc.pkl + btc_otc_0.5_0.{01,05,1}.csv (one CSV per negative-sample ratio)
notes: Preprocessed CSVs are distributed on Google Drive by the GeneralDyG authors; graflag_data fetches them via gdown (install with `pip install graflag_data[gdrive]`). btc_otc.pkl is regenerated automatically on first run by methods/generaldyg/train_graflag.py (which invokes GeneralDyG's src/generate_datasets.py inside the container).
